economic_protocol.bar_grid: every UTC five-minute bar-open in [split_start, split_end_exclusive); bar interval is [open_time, open_time+5m)
economic_protocol.champion_selection: among train and selection qualifiers, maximize selection CAGR/strict MDD; tie by lower selection strict MDD then variant_id
economic_protocol.exit: 5m open exactly H calendar days after entry

familywise_test.centering: subtract each variant's 2023 sample mean before resampling
familywise_test.controls: diagnostic only and excluded from champion selection
familywise_test.method: one-sided Romano-Wolf max-t circular block bootstrap
familywise_test.selection_period: 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31 UTC daily net log equity returns
familywise_test.synchronization: same circular seven-day block indices for every variant

funding.coverage: exactly one BTCUSDT funding row at every UTC 00:00, 08:00, and 16:00 timestamp in the full split
funding.timing: every Binance funding timestamp strictly after entry and at or before exit

economic_protocol.marking: validate the complete split bar/funding grids; visit every bar open, all fully-held strict extremes, every close, both execution costs, and each in-position funding cash flow; flat intervals carry equity

market_access_seal.must_be_committed_before: any 2024+ BTC market or funding read

opening_preconditions: source-access seal validates real path hashes and is committed before 2024+ news
source is downloaded without feature/outcome inspection
market-access seal binds source seal, 912 rows, source output, and manifest
post_selection_oos.source_grid_validation: parse the hashed gzip CSV and require exact sorted unique dates plus the frozen +48h15m availability clock
post_selection_oos.transport: identical queries, daily grid, and +48h15m availability clock

economic_protocol.strict_intrabar_order: for every fully held bar after entry and strictly before exit, visit favorable extreme then adverse extreme before close (LONG high then low; SHORT low then high); exit occurs at the scheduled bar open before that bar's extremes
economic_protocol.strict_mdd: maximum (running_peak_equity - strict_path_equity) / running_peak_equity over the full calendar 5m path including flat and intratrade marks

familywise_test.method: one-sided Romano-Wolf step-down max-t circular block bootstrap

implementation_conventions.daily_return_endpoint: UTC calendar-day final 5m close equity; first day starts at split initial equity
implementation_conventions.funding_clock: validate exact Binance fundingTime and use its audited floor-to-8h mark_open_time as the preregistered complete settlement grid
implementation_conventions.romano_wolf: standard descending-observed-t step-down; maximum bootstrap t over each remaining hypothesis set; exact observed-t ties leave the set together; plus-one p-value correction and monotonicity enforcement
